recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No core follow-up is needed for FHIR-7990 unless a future work group decision changes _id search response semantics.
issue_request: FHIR-7990 was Published/Persuasive and asked to change broad read-equivalence wording so it specifically said search with parameter _id returns a bundle with the requested resource rather than the resource itself.
initial_application: The request was applied in git-svn commit 0f05c40d4974ffef702077b745646502c536f52a, matching the Jira comment for svn revision 6471; that commit changed source/search.html to name _id search and mention additional search functionality such as _include.
additional_context: Later search-page reorganizations moved the topic into the current Searching Identifiers / Logical Identifiers section and a separate _id parameter section. Current source says logical-id search is performed with _id, search operations always return bundles, an existing logical id returns a bundle containing the resource instead of the resource itself, missing/non-returnable ids still produce a bundle for valid searches, and additional search features such as inclusion remain available. No direct Zulip or Confluence record was found that reverses FHIR-7990; a 2022 implementers discussion aligns with the current distinction.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No source edit was made because the active source already conveys the accepted _id-specific bundle clarification more completely than the original 2015 wording.
